messages.subject: HELP!!!!
parts:
Hello,

I am working with an excel database with 4000 cases who contain journals information, it it basically titles and resumes of news. What I need to do is an automatic coding so then work with and index for different categories. For example I need to clasify Regions, so I want that all those regions names becomes a number, etc.

I have been working with the "tm" package, I will paste my script.

Can anyone help me??

THANKSSS!!!


#############CARGAR BASE EXCEL######################
library("RODBC")## Paquete que me permite abrir bases en excel
noticias <- odbcConnectExcel2007("prueba.xlxs")
library(xlsx) ##cargo base en excel
loadWorkbook("prueba.xlsx")
noticias <- read.xlsx("prueba.xlsx", sheetName = "mysheet", header = TRUE) ### column.names = me crea una variable nueva
summary(noticias)
names(noticias)

#####MANEJO TEXTO ##############
library(tm) ### Cargo paquete "tm" (text mining)
corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(noticias))

#Ahora quiero limpiar mi base, de puntuaciones, palabras vacías, espacios en blanco y llevar a minusculas (tolower)

cleanCorpus <- function(corpus) {
corpus.tmp <- tm_map(corpus, removePunctuation)
corpus.tmp <- tm_map(corpus.tmp, stripWhitespace)
corpus.tmp <- tm_map(corpus.tmp,tolower)}

tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(corpus) ##crea matriz de términos
findFreqTerms(tdm, 20)   #Me busca frecuencia de palabraslibrary(wordcloud)
corpus

corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeWords, c("los", "por", "que")) ##me elimina palabras con alta frecuencia que no me sirven
tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(corpus)
inspect(tdm)
